STEP 3. Using the oscilloscope, check the waveform at 
PCM connector C-57 <2.4L Engine> or C-59 <3.0L Engine>.
(1) Do not disconnect connector C-57<2.4L Engine> or C-59 
<3.0L Engine>.
(2) Connect an oscilloscope probe to PCM connector C-
57<2.4L Engine> or C-59 <3.0L Engine> terminal 80 by 
backprobing.
(3) Start the engine.
(4) Check the waveform.
• The waveform should show a pattern similar to the 
illustration when running the vehicle.
(5) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the waveform normal?
YES : Go to Step 5.
NO : Go to Step 4.
